title: Gelium Screen Recipe Contract
description: Machine-readable form of the 19-field Gelium screen recipe template (docs/gelium-ui-screen-composition.md §3) plus protocol fields (intent, flow_ref, decision rules). Opaque identifier, not a resolvable URL. Worked examples live in docs/gelium/schemas/contracts/.

schema.description: Exact schema ID this instance conforms to.

screen_type.description: Closed vocabulary of screen types (recipe families of the system).

intent.description: The product-level goal this screen participates in (Intent layer, ux-composition-model.md).

flow_ref.description: Reference to the flow contract this screen belongs to (matches the fragment of a flow.schema.json instance, e.g. 'inbox').

user.description: The actor pursuing the primary task, described by task — not the system role (19-field USER).

primary_task.description: What the user does on this surface (19-field PRIMARY_TASK).

ux_pattern.description: Pattern registry references, e.g. 'E3 Resource list', 'F2 Hero/Billboard' (pattern-registry.md D1-D8, E1-E19, F1-F14).

visual_vocabulary.description: Components and their visual role (19-field VISUAL_VOCABULARY).

components.description: Exact registry component names — zero new primitives (component-registry.md §2).

states.description: Closed state vocabulary (state matrix, composition-rules.md §8). Every data surface declares empty, loading and error (R-STATE-01).

content_rules.description: Content obligations satisfied by the screen (content-rules.md).

json_ld.description: Whether the surface emits structured data (JSON-LD).

entity.description: The unique brand entity of the system (geo-contract.md).

factual.description: Content is factual/citable; no unverified universal claims.

json_ld_types.description: Structured-data types emitted by the surface (geo-contract.md §14 table).

get_params.description: Stable GET params and their closed vocabularies, e.g. {"q":"free text","sort":"closed vocabulary"}. Empty object when none.

transient_feedback.description: Transient feedback via HX-Trigger loom:toast only (R-FEEDBACK-03).

post_only_paths.description: POST-only routes registered in postOnlyPaths(); GET on them returns 405 (R-NOJS-02).

fragment_swap.description: HTMX fragment swapped on reading requests (hx-get).

notes.description: Contract caveats (e.g. example vs production variant).

no_js_flow.description: Complete non-JS branch: GET links, native forms, POST + 303, server-rendered overlays (R-NOJS-01).

htmx_enhancement.description: Progressive enhancement only; never changes the mutation contract (R-NOJS-03).

theme_requirements.description: Tokens --ui-* only, zero literals, forced-colors/reduced-motion by primitives (P10).

alternatives_rejected.description: Patterns/anti-rules considered and rejected, with reason (composition-rules.md §4/§5).

rationale.description: Answers the six rationale questions of composition-rules.md §11.

decision_rules.description: IDs of the decision rules (ux-decision-rules.md) this screen exercises. Every ID must exist in the rule catalog.
